_note: Transcription of the exact Railway Template Composer settings for the Laravel AI SDK starter. Railway does NOT read this file automatically — enter these settings in the Template Composer when publishing, and check the published page against this file. Reference variable values are set by the Template Composer at publish time; verify them against the published page. sourceRepo/sourceBranch are set at publish time, once the GitHub repo exists — do not invent a repo URL before then.
description: Laravel 13 starter with the AI SDK, Postgres and healthcheck
name: Laravel AI SDK Starter
notIncluded: Auth scaffolding (no users, no login, no tokens)
Any AI provider key — the demo reports configured: false until you set one
Vector store, embeddings pipeline, or RAG — the demo is one text agent call

build.note: Dockerfile pins php:8.5.12-fpm-alpine exactly. Railpack/Nixpacks resolve PHP fuzzily and cannot pin the patch — see Dockerfile header.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic key for the demo agent (tried after OpenAI).

APP_KEY.description: Laravel encryption key. Generated at deploy time — never ship a real value in this repo.

APP_URL.description: Public URL of the deployed app (the Railway domain, once generated).

DATABASE_URL.description: Connection string for the Postgres service in this template.

DB_CONNECTION.description: Database driver. pgsql on Railway; sqlite only for local parity testing.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Google Gemini key for the demo agent (tried after Anthropic).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Set ONE provider key to make the demo call a real model. OpenAI is tried first.

services.name: Postgres
services.note: PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector, built from this repo (docker/postgres/Dockerfile): the official postgres:18.7 image, digest pinned, plus pgvector 0.8.7 from PGDG. Replaces Railway's stock postgres-ssl:18, which has no pgvector, while keeping its contract: same major version, same volume layout (PGDATA pinned to /var/lib/postgresql/data), same variables, TLS on by default via a self-signed certificate generated at first init. Existing deployments are snapshots and are not changed by this template update; if an owner applies the update, the new image starts on their existing data directory and pgvector becomes available with no data change. The app connects over the private network via DATABASE_URL.

source.note: Builds the template's own PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector image from this repo.

DATABASE_URL.description: Connection string for other services in the same project. Defined on the Postgres service itself because a repo-built service does not get one generated for it.

PGDATA.description: Data directory, pinned to the layout the stock Railway image uses so existing volumes keep working. Also set as ENV in the image; declared here so it is visible in the deploy form.

PG_SSL.description: on (default): at first init a self-signed TLS certificate is generated into the data directory and ssl is switched on. off skips that and runs without TLS.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Application database, created at first init. The vector extension is created in it at first init.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Generated at deploy time by the template secret() function. The alphabet is deliberately URL-safe (letters, digits, dash, underscore): the password is embedded in DATABASE_URL, and a '/' from a base64 alphabet breaks URI parsing in libpq (proven live on the PostgreSQL 19 template, 2026-11-20). Never a literal value.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Database superuser, same as the stock Railway image.

volumes.note: Persistent volume. Without it, data is lost on redeploy. Same mount path as the stock image used, so an existing deployment that applies this update keeps its data in place.
